newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan turnover ends at record T$297 billion.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan turnover ends at record T$297 billion.

text.p: Turnover in Taiwan's red-hot stock market rocketed on Thursday to end at an all-time high T$297 billion (US$10.65 billion), eclipsing the T$262 billion set on Tuesday.
The new high was the latest in a yearlong string of eye-popping turnover records that have vaulted Taiwan's stock market into the ranks of the world's most active markets.

The huge turnover has triggered concerns over possible distortion in Taiwan's money and foreign exchange markets, having the effect of siphoning huge flows of liquidity from both markets into the stock market.
Short-term interest rates have been highly volatile during the most recent stock rally, spiking into double digits in late June on a stock rally-induced liquidity squeeze.
The overnight interbank rate stood at 7.749 percent at mid-session on Thursday compared to Wednesday's 7.437 close.
